name: Power Jammer - Armor
RelatedDescription: A miniaturized power supply unit that can be attached to an ST to raise its load limit. Also integrates a function that affects the enemy's Armor capability.

61007.name: Power Boost III · Armor
61007.SpecificEffects:
ST gains an extra <color=#F74848>300</color> Power.
In combat, the enemy's Armor <color=#F74848>-50%</color>.
ST Body's HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>, DMG Dealt <color=#F74848>+5%</color>.
